answer: Because the dune reference is updated at each gale checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the fable audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 174 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
